name: two days, the second a half
content: Ciao Lorenzo, ti confermo le giornate del 3 e 4 febbraio, la seconda mezza. Grazie!

name: relative weekdays with a half day
content: ok for Thursday and Friday, but Friday is a half day

name: a range, weekend excluded
content: Approved: Wednesday 4 March through Monday 9 March inclusive, full days.

name: a range with one day carved out
content: Va bene per tutta la settimana prossima, dal 13 al 17, tranne mercoledì che sono in ferie.

name: nothing is approved, it is a question
content: Thanks for the estimate. Before I approve anything, can you tell me how many days the migration would take?

name: nothing is approved, the contract is being sent
content: In allegato il contratto firmato. Ci sentiamo la settimana prossima per programmare.

name: a revocation of a day approved earlier
content: Scusa, devo disdire la giornata di giovedì 14. Confermo invece venerdì 15.

name: tomorrow, in the middle of a longer message
content: Hi, the invoice from last month is being processed by finance and should be paid this week. Separately: yes, go ahead tomorrow for the security review, one day is fine.

name: two half days on different dates
content: Ok per mezza giornata martedì 7 e mezza giovedì 9.

name: a date written as a weekday plus a number, next month
content: Confirmed for Thursday 1 October, full day, and Friday 2 October, full day.

name: an approval that also mentions a date that is not a day of work
content: Confermo la giornata del 18 febbraio. La fattura di gennaio, emessa il 31 gennaio, la paghiamo entro il 28.

name: next week with no weekday named
content: Let us do two full days next week, Tuesday and Wednesday.
